line: You don’t need an hour.
land: You need the version that actually happens.
alt: Navy quote card. You don't need an hour. You need the version that actually happens.

line: Burnout rarely announces itself.
land: It looks like hitting every deadline and enjoying none of it.

line: There’s no time to waste.
land: Use what you’ve got, and use it well.

line: You don’t need a crisis to justify taking care of yourself.

line: Almost nobody is handling it as well as they look.

line: “Who would notice if I stopped?”
land: If the answer is nobody, that’s the real problem.

line: The most effective things cost nothing.

line: You gained back a commute.

line: You didn’t fail that plan.

line: 60 seconds to reset.
land: 4 in. Hold 4. 4 out. Four times.

line: You can’t outsource noticing.

line: People don’t change because they got inspired.

line: Habits don’t die from lack of willpower.

line: “I’m fine” is the most common thing people say when they’re not.

line: Build the plan around your worst day.

line: Rest isn’t a reward.

line: You’re not trying to make progress this quarter.
